en.headline: Hang Seng falls about 240 points after Federal Reserve hike
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks opened lower on Thursday as investors digested the first US rate increase since 2023 and the HKMA’s matching lift in the Base Rate.
body: The Hang Seng Index was about 240 points, or 1 per cent, lower in Thursday morning trade, reversing Wednesday’s modest gain after the US Federal Reserve raised its policy rate by a quarter point.

Data compiled by Hong Kong Economic Journal around mid-morning put the index near 24,473, after an opening print of about 24,481. The Hang Seng Tech Index was down more than 1 per cent, and the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index also declined. Turnover at that stage was still building after the open.

The Hong Kong Monetary Authority earlier on Thursday set the Base Rate at 4.25 per cent under its linked-rate formula, the first increase since 2023. Monetary Authority Chief Executive Eddie Yue told a radio programme that the path of US rates remains uncertain and will continue to shape Hong Kong’s interest-rate environment.
The index closed on Wednesday at 24,714, up 47 points. Brokers said the market had already given back more than 1,000 points from this month’s high before the Federal Reserve decision.

zh.headline: 聯儲局加息後恒指早市下跌約240點
zh.dek: 港股周四早段低開，投資者消化美國三年來首次加息，以及金管局同步上調基本利率。
body: 恒生指數周四早市下跌約240點，或1%，扭轉周三輕微升幅，因應美國聯儲局將政策利率上調四分一厘。
據信報上午編纂的數據，恒指徘徊24,473點附近，開市報約24,481點。恒生科技指數跌逾1%，國企指數亦下跌。開市後成交額仍在累積。
金管局周四早前按聯繫匯率公式將基本利率定於4.25厘，為2023年以來首次上調。金管局總裁余偉文在電台節目表示，美國息率走勢仍不明朗，將繼續影響本港利率環境。
恒指周三收市報24,714點，升47點。有經紀指出，大市在聯儲局議息前已較本月高位回吐逾1,000點。
